summary: Sysmenu 5: rebuild the system menu to the mockup
author: pm
body:
Left tab column and Log Out, settings pane with Display and Quality sections, dropdowns and check boxes; every existing setting kept; General opens by default.

Plan: .claude/design/plans/system-menu-display-overhaul.md (part of HH-0114).

**Done when:** built, reviewed and checked in game.

**Carried from HH-0116 review, 2026-11-25:** skip direct wheel reads while a dropdown is open (is_open()/list_bounds()); clip option text; call set_screen_size; discard_pending_input when re-shown; defer rebuilds from check-box on_change; field shade awaits the user (d-037).

**User, 2026-11-25:** the open dropdown list uses the kit inset bevel for its border ("Can we use the inset for the border?") and keeps its darker stone-cloth background ("keep the darker background though"). panel_kit.cpp skin_dropdown currently draws bevel_box_g3_raised: switch it to the inner inset bevel in this sub-task. Mockup: .claude/scratch/coordinator/sysmenu_mockup/b2.png.

**User, 2026-11-25:** "add a drop shadow behind the drop down? distance of 0 so it just shows a faint shadow behind". Mockup: black at alpha 150/255, Gaussian blur radius 4, no offset, all round the open list (replaces the 3 px offset shadow). Implement in skin_dropdown.

**User, 2026-11-25:** "Only the left, right and bottom" - the 0-distance shadow is clipped at the list's top edge (no shadow above).

**User, 2026-11-25:** "Slightly darker shadow?" - shadow alpha 200/255 (was 150), blur 4, left/right/bottom.

**User, 2026-11-25:** "Increase the visibility of it" - shadow now black alpha 255, blur radius 6, composited twice, left/right/bottom (supersedes the 200/4 values).

**Tab layout, user 2026-11-25:** "Add a gameplay and leave general mostly empty as it will be for general information, ping, etc..."
- General (default): information only - server name, date and time, ping/latency readout; room for more info later.
- Graphics: Display (Window Mode, Resolution, Refresh Rate, VSync, Aspect; staged except VSync) and Quality (Detail Level, Transparency, Antialias Font, Antialias Buffer, Map Zoom), plus Show FPS, Show Latency, Power Saving; Tile/Patching Grid where they show today.
- Audio: Master, Effects, Ambient.
- Gameplay: Running Mode, Capture Mouse, Reduced Motion, Toggle to Chat.
- Left column: Log Out / Continue, Restart (when dead).

**Editor, 2026-11-26 (checkpoint 9dc5ebf4, not committed):**
- The menu is rebuilt to b2 (420x303, gold corners) with every control a CControls control in one collection. Labels and section headings are `cc::label`s, sliders and the scrollbar are `cc::button`s that drag while held, and the popup is a panel. Values are synced from the settings every frame, so no callback rebuilds anything. The mouse reaches the controls only when the menu is the dialog under it (new `DialogBoxManager::dialog_at_mouse`) or a press began on it. Keys are not passed, so they stay with chat and hotkeys. `set_screen_size(dialog right, dialog bottom)` keeps open lists inside the dialog. The menu's own wheel is skipped while a list is open. A press on a control or open list claims the press, so the dialog does not drag.
- Tabs: General (Server, Date / Time, Ping), Graphics (Display: Window Mode, Resolution, Refresh Rate, VSync, Aspect, Borderless Window; Quality: Detail Level, Transparency, Antialias Font, Antialias Buffer, Map Zoom; Interface: Show FPS, Show Latency, Power Saving, plus Tile Grid and Patching Grid in Debug), Audio, Gameplay. Restart (when dead) sits above Log Out / Continue. The page scrolls by whole rows (wheel or scrollbar); rows partly outside the pane are hidden.
- **Needs the user:** settings the tab lists did not name were kept because "every existing setting kept" requires it. Audio also has UI and Music, each row being an on/off box plus a slider. Gameplay has a "Chat and Map" section with Whisper, Shout and Guide Map. Graphics has Borderless Window (the old Window Style). Move or drop them on the user's word.
- Kit (`panel_kit.cpp`): the open list now has the inset bevel over the darker cloth, and a 0-distance shadow on the left, right and bottom only: the halo of a Gaussian blur (sigma 6) composited twice at alpha 255, drawn as one ring per distance. `form_style` swaps `shadow` / `shadow_offset` for `shadow` / `shadow_blur` / `shadow_passes`. The new `clipped_text` clips field and row text (the field stops short of the arrow). The new `text_recolored` recolours a fixed-colour recipe: field_label ignores the fill, so greyed labels and the red pending text needed it.
- Docs drift: `.claude/docs/ccontrols-reference/forms.md` still says "px_black drop shadow ... and the raised bevel" for the list. It now uses the inset bevel and the blurred shadow.
- Verified in game: every tab, the open lists (scrolling Resolution list, wheel scrolls the list and not the pane), the clipped desktop label, the greying, the pending footer, the popup, the slider drag (masterVolume saved on release) and the pane scroll. Captures are in .claude/scratch/editor/hh0119/. Not verified: Exclusive Fullscreen (not applied on this desktop), dialog transparency look (text stays opaque, as before), Linux run.

**Verified, 2026-11-26:** in game - staging, Apply, the 15 s popup (timeout, Revert, Keep both ways), VSync live, every tab, dropdown lists, greying, pending footer, wheel on an open list, slider save on release, drag, Log Out/Continue; review PASS after fixes (logout/map-change revert, stale confirm, effective-size save). Not verified: exclusive fullscreen, Restart, a Linux run. User to confirm the extra rows (UI/Music sliders, Whisper/Shout/Guide Map, Borderless Window).
